name: osf
description: A library and command line programs for working with FadeIn and Open Screenplay Format (osf) files.
releaseNotes: Modernization to the workspace standard. Go 1.27.3 is the minimum version. The three programs (fadein2osf, osf2txt, txt2osf) use the standard library flag package instead of github.com/caltechlibrary/cli, with -h, -l and -v beside the long spellings. Requires fountain v1.0.4. Fixed: txt2osf (FromFountain) wrote each paragraph's kind as a bookmark attribute, so Fade In could not tell a scene heading from action; it now writes <style basestylename="..."/> as Fade In's own files do, and no longer writes an empty paragraph for each Fountain blank line. Also fixed in txt2osf: Fountain forcing markers (!, @, ~, ., >) are no longer left in the text, title page values are trimmed, and inline emphasis (*italic*, **bold**, ***both***, _underline_) becomes formatted text runs instead of literal asterisks. osf2txt applies a paragraph's style once, not once per text run. Test coverage of the library rose from 28% to 97%. The 32-bit Raspberry Pi (armv7l) target is dropped. The release scripts follow the workspace standard (a release is built from a clean, pushed commit, and an interrupted draft release resumes).
